issue.title: Stabilize notification custom-gate tracked-executor test under full-suite load
issue.description: Clean-tree landing verification for sase-f1 on 2026-08-03 reached the full pytest stage after lint/validation passed, then failed tests/ace/tui/test_notification_custom_gate.py::test_tracked_executor_reports_terminal_and_extra_commands_live in the 26-worker just check run. The exact node passed immediately afterward when rerun with the known lock-timeout node through just test, so this appears to be full-suite load/order sensitivity rather than a deterministic code regression. Scope: reproduce the full-suite or parallel-order dependence, identify the notification/custom-gate tracked executor state leak or timing issue, and make the test deterministic without weakening the terminal/extra-command assertions.

payload.close_reason: Backlog triage 2026-08-05: consolidating the full-parallel-suite / xdist flake class onto umbrella task sase-ct ('Flaky ACE TUI tests under full parallel just test run'). Every one of these reports the same shape — a single node fails under the full four-to-27-worker 'just test' or 'just check' run and passes immediately in isolation — so they share a root-cause class (xdist load sensitivity and shared-state leakage across workers) rather than per-test logic bugs. Per-test detail, including sase-cu's pump-free clipboard-task diagnosis, stays readable on each bead, and a +1 with fresh evidence reopens any of them if a specific node turns into a deterministic failure.
